nodes.label: VpnService
nodes.rationale: VPN-based approach chosen to capture all traffic on Android without root, since OS-level system proxy is not available like on desktop Tauri.

nodes.label: Fake DNS Server
nodes.rationale: Intercepts DNS queries to assign fake IPs to bypass domains, enabling domain recovery at the Xray routing layer without requiring per-app VPN configuration.

nodes.label: hev-socks5-tunnel
nodes.rationale: Bridges raw TUN IP packets to SOCKS5, reassembling TCP/UDP sessions so Xray-core can process them without direct TUN access.

nodes.label: Xray-core
nodes.rationale: Chosen over trojan-go as the protocol core for Android; provides SOCKS5 inbound, Trojan outbound with TLS 1.3, and domain-based routing rules.

nodes.label: DomainRouter
nodes.rationale: Ports Rust router.rs logic: O(1) exact match, suffix index for wildcard matching, fallback full scan. Thread-safe via ConcurrentHashMap.

nodes.label: Censorship Circumvention
nodes.rationale: Core design goal: route specific bypass domains through Trojan proxy while sending everything else direct, achieving selective censorship circumvention.

nodes.label: Traffic Capture via VPN
nodes.rationale: Key architectural decision: VPN-based TUN interface captures all device traffic (0.0.0.0/0) because Android lacks OS-level system proxy support like desktop.

nodes.label: Selective Proxying via Domain Routing
nodes.rationale: Only bypass domains are routed through Trojan; direct outbound handles everything else. This minimizes proxy load and latency for non-restricted traffic.

nodes.label: Fake-IP DNS Interception Pattern
nodes.rationale: Fake DNS assigns IPs from 198.18.0.0/15 to bypass domains, allowing Xray-core to recover the original domain from the fake IP at the routing layer.

nodes.label: SECURE ACCESS TO A FREE INTERNET
nodes.norm_label: secure access to a free internet
